profiles.description: Clean Energy Technologies, Inc. (CETY) specializes in developing, manufacturing, and marketing innovative clean energy products and comprehensive solutions, with a core focus on enhancing energy efficiency and harnessing renewable resources. The company operates through three distinct segments: Clean Energy Solutions, CETY Europe, and its Electronic Manufacturing Business. Its flagship product, the Clean Cycle, efficiently converts residual heat from industrial operations, waste-to-energy processes, and power generation facilities into electricity. Beyond this, the company specializes in transforming diverse waste streams – originating from manufacturing, agriculture, and wastewater treatment plants – into valuable energy outputs such as electricity, renewable natural gas, hydrogen, and biochar. Furthermore, CETY offers a broad spectrum of services, including electrical, mechanical, and software engineering, alongside consulting, project management, and supply chain oversight. Initially known as Probe Manufacturing, Inc., the company adopted its current name, Clean Energy Technologies, Inc., in November 2015. Founded in 1995, it is headquartered in Costa Mesa, California, and functions as a subsidiary of MGW Investments I Limited.
